festivals.name: Durga Puja
festivals.about: Bengaluru's community pujas run from Panchami on Thursday 15 October, when many hold an Anandamela of home-cooked Bengali food, to Bijoya Dashami on Wednesday 21 October. Everyone is welcome: go for the idols and pandal themes, the bhog, dhunuchi naach and the evening culture programmes.
festivals.teaser: Pandal hopping across the city's community pujas: the idols, the bhog, dhunuchi naach and the evening cultural programmes.
tips: Check your pandal's own schedule for Ashtami: almanacs differ this year. EBCA, Sanskritik and Aikatan hold the Ashtami pushpanjali on Sunday 18 October with Sandhi Puja at 7:26–8:14 am on Monday 19 October. Jayamahal does Ashtami on the 19th, with Sandhi Puja at 10:27–11:15 am.

Thursday 15 October (Panchami) is Anandamela night at many pujas, including Sarathi, the Bengalee Association, SCA Indiranagar, RT Nagar, SBCA and Jayamahal: home-cooked Bengali food before the puja proper begins.

For bhog, go around lunchtime. EBCA serves free bhog 11:30 am–1 pm (a special bhog 2–4 pm on Ashtami and Navami), Sanskritik 1–3 pm and Jayamahal around 1–1:30 pm. Sarathi takes take-away bhog bookings on its website.
Ashtami and Navami evenings bring the heaviest crowds, traffic and parking trouble. See the big Koramangala pujas (Sarathi, with Kolaj nearby) before evening.
Metro-friendly: BARSHA is right behind Electronic City station and ECCA is about 400 m from it (Yellow Line); PBCA at KTPO is about 400 m from Kundalahalli (Purple Line).
Pandals are spread across the city. For several in one day, an hourly cab rental usually beats single rides.
EBCA Whitefield asks visitors to book a free QR entry pass on allevents. Dandiya nights, such as ECCA's on 20 October, are ticketed.
Apartment pujas, such as Prestige Shantiniketan's, may close their gates to non-residents when crowded, so if you're coming from elsewhere, pick the big association grounds.

festivals.name: Deepavali
festivals.about: Families shop the old markets for diyas, akash kandils, flowers, silk and lights, and buy green crackers from police-licensed temporary stalls (411 stalls in 2025). Bursting is allowed only from 8 to 10 pm, per the Supreme Court direction. Balipadyami is the main Deepavali holiday in Karnataka; a 2021 Muzrai order set Gopuja (cow worship) at state temples that evening.
festivals.teaser: Diyas, lanterns and flowers in the old markets, green crackers from 8 to 10 pm, and the whole city lit up.
festivals.dateNote: Drik Panchang (Bengaluru) Diwali calendar: Dhanteras 6 Nov, Narak Chaturdashi and Lakshmi Puja Sun 8 Nov, Govardhan Puja/Bali Pratipada Tue 10 Nov, Bhaiya Dooj Wed 11 Nov (https://www.drikpanchang.com/diwali/diwali-puja-calendar.html?geoname-id=1277333&year=2026). Abhyanga snana timing is from https://www.drikpanchang.com/festivals/abhyangsnan/festivals-abhyangsnan-timings.html?geoname-id=1277333. Karnataka Govt 2026 list: Balipadyami/Deepavali Tue 10 Nov is a general holiday. Naraka Chaturdashi 8 Nov is not a holiday because it falls on a Sunday (https://www.sakshipost.com/news/national/karnataka-releases-2026-holiday-calendar-full-list-general-and-restricted-holidays). DoPT 2026: Diwali Sun 8 Nov (https://www.staffnews.in/2025/07/list-of-holidays-2026-closed-holidays.html); restricted holidays Naraka Chaturdasi 8 Nov, Govardhan Puja Mon 9 Nov, Bhai Duj 11 Nov (https://www.staffnews.in/2025/07/list-of-holidays-2026-restricted-holidays.html). DISAGREEMENT: Govardhan Puja is 9 Nov in DoPT but Bali Pratipada is 10 Nov in Drik and Karnataka. Some aggregators (BankBazaar) give a Deepavali holiday on 9 Nov.

festivals.name: Kadalekai Parishe
festivals.about: A centuries-old groundnut fair. Farmers offer their first groundnut harvest to the giant Nandi at Dodda Basavana Gudi, and vendors line Bull Temple Road selling raw, boiled and roasted groundnuts, toys and snacks. The road is closed to traffic and the fair has been run plastic-free (2025). Malleswaram holds a separate, earlier groundnut fair (8-10 Nov in 2025).
festivals.teaser: The centuries-old groundnut fair on Bull Temple Road, Basavanagudi: groundnuts by the sackful, toys and snacks.
festivals.dateNote: NOT ANNOUNCED as of 10 Oct 2026. The Muzrai Department and GBA usually announce it in November. The fair is held on the last Monday of Kartika masa (amanta). In 2026 Kartika runs from 10 Nov to the Amavasya of 8 Dec (https://www.drikpanchang.com/vrats/amavasyadates.html?geoname-id=1277333&year=2026), so the expected main day is Mon 7 Dec 2026. This rule matches the past dates: Mon 11 Dec 2023, Mon 25 Nov 2024 (2 days, 25-26 Nov) and Mon 17 Nov 2025 (first 5-day edition, to 21 Nov). The 'to' date of 11 Dec assumes the 2025 five-day format repeats, and the length depends on the Muzrai announcement. Sources: https://www.oneindia.com/bengaluru/basavanagudi-kadalekai-parishe-2025-five-day-groundnut-fair-runs-until-november-21-7919019.html ; https://www.oneindia.com/bengaluru/kadalekai-parishe-2024-bengaluru-s-iconic-groundnut-fair-on-november-25-26-011-3991007.html. Travebrate also estimates 7 Dec 2026, and Incredible India says only 'November 2026'.

festivals.name: Makara Sankranti
festivals.about: Families exchange ellu-bella (a sesame, jaggery, coconut and groundnut mix) and sugarcane and shop at the old markets. In the evening, crowds gather at Gavi Gangadhareshwara cave temple to watch sunlight pass between the Nandi's horns and touch the Shivalinga.

festivals.dateNote: Drik Panchang (Bengaluru): Makara Sankranti Fri 15 Jan 2027, because the Sankranti moment is 9:14 pm on 14 Jan (https://www.drikpanchang.com/sankranti/makar-sankranti-date-time.html?geoname-id=1277333&year=2027). DoPT 2027 restricted list: Makar Sankranti Thu 14 Jan, Pongal Fri 15 Jan (https://www.staffnews.in/2026/07/list-of-restricted-holidays-for-the-year-2027.html). DISAGREEMENT: unofficial Karnataka 2027 lists (CalendarLabs) say 14 Jan (https://www.calendarlabs.com/karnataka-state-holidays-2027/), but the Karnataka holiday list for 2027 has not been notified yet. In 2026 the state observed the day after the Sankranti moment. The evening sun-ray event at Gavi Gangadhareshwara will be on the state's Sankranti day; its 2027 time is not published.

festivals.dateNote: Drik Panchang (Bengaluru): Dhanteras 27 Oct, Narak Chaturdashi 28 Oct, Lakshmi Puja Fri 29 Oct, Bali Pratipada/Govardhan Puja Sat 30 Oct, Bhaiya Dooj Sun 31 Oct 2027 (https://www.drikpanchang.com/diwali/diwali-puja-calendar.html?geoname-id=1277333&year=2027). DoPT 2027: Diwali Fri 29 Oct (gazetted, https://www.staffnews.in/2026/07/list-of-holidays-for-the-year-2027-gazetted.html); Naraka Chaturdasi 28 Oct, Govardhan Puja 30 Oct, Bhai Duj 31 Oct (restricted, https://www.staffnews.in/2026/07/list-of-restricted-holidays-for-the-year-2027.html). Not yet notified: the Karnataka 2027 list. CalendarLabs' unofficial list puts Naraka Chaturdashi on 28 Oct and 'Balipadyami/Deepavali' on 29 Oct (https://www.calendarlabs.com/karnataka-state-holidays-2027/), so which day is the state holiday is still expected.
